question: In which of the following places is the headquarters of Eastern Command of Indian Army located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Eastern Command is one of the six operational commands of the Indian Army.
 
• It is headquartered in Fort William in the city of **Kolkata in the state of West Bengal.**
 
• The Eastern Command was formed on** 1 November 1920. **

The army is organized into the following seven commands:

• Indian Army is the second-largest army in the world.
 
• 'Service Before Self' is the motto of the Indian Army.
 
• Indian Army is commanded by the Chief of Army Staff.
 
• General Manoj Pande is the current chief of Indian Army. (As of Nov 2022)
